description: Change the reverse DNS entry for one of a server's public IPv4 or IPv6 addresses. Set dns_ptr to null to reset to the default.

dns_ptr.description: Reverse DNS PTR record value, or null to reset to the default

ip.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address of the server to set the reverse DNS entry for

title: Change Server Reverse DNS
